sentences.text:
The petitioner was convicted for the  offence under Section 376 IPC and Section 6(2)
 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo  rigorous imprisonment for 20 years and also to  pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/- for the offence under Section 6 of POCSO Act, in default, simple  imprisonment for a period of 3 months, and fine  amount is ordered to be paid to PW-1 after the  appeal time is over as contemplated under Section 6(2) of POCSO Act, vide Judgment dated  13.03.2020 in S.C.No. 291 of 2019 on the file of  the Court of the Special Judge for protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act-cum-  Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge,
 Vijayawada.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the  petitioner herein submits that the alleged incident  is said to have taken place in the year 2020.
Learned Sessions Judge, passed the Judgment  relying upon the amendment, which has been  made to the POCSO Act and sentenced the  petitioner/ appellant herein for a period of 20  years.
The petitioner/ appellant herein has been  languishing in jail for more than 5 years.
2  Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the Respondent/ State, on instructions, submitted the nominal roll of the petitioner/ appellant herein.

The Criminal Appeal is of the year 2020.
There is no possibility of appeal coming up for hearing in near future.
In all probability, by the time the appeal is heard, the petitioner would be served out entire sentence.
In these circumstances, since the petitioner underwent sentence of more than 5 years, out of 20 years imposed, this Court is of the view that it would be a fit and proper case to allow the petition.
In view of the aforementioned circumstances, sentence of imprisonment alone is suspended pending disposal of the Criminal Appeal.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner was convicted for the  offence under Section 376 IPC and Section 6(2)
 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo  rigorous imprisonment for 20 years and also to  pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/- for the offence under Section 6 of POCSO Act, in default, simple  imprisonment for a period of 3 months, and fine  amount is ordered to be paid to PW-1 after the  appeal time is over as contemplated under Section 6(2) of POCSO Act, vide Judgment dated  13.03.2020 in S.C.No. 291 of 2019 on the file of  the Court of the Special Judge for protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act-cum-  Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge,
 Vijayawada.
Learned Sessions Judge, passed the Judgment  relying upon the amendment, which has been  made to the POCSO Act and sentenced the  petitioner/ appellant herein for a period of 20  years.

opennyai_summary.arguments: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the  petitioner herein submits that the alleged incident  is said to have taken place in the year 2020.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
A perusal of the record shows that for the last 5 years and 20 days the petitioner has been languishing in the jail and the conduct of the petitioner/ appellant in jail is reported as satisfactory.
In these circumstances, since the petitioner underwent sentence of more than 5 years, out of 20 years imposed, this Court is of the view that it would be a fit and proper case to allow the petition.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The Criminal Appeal is of the year 2020.
There is no possibility of appeal coming up for hearing in near future.
In all probability, by the time the appeal is heard, the petitioner would be served out entire sentence.
In view of the aforementioned circumstances, sentence of imprisonment alone is suspended pending disposal of the Criminal Appeal.
The petitioner/ appellant shall be released on bail on condition of his executing a personal bond of Rs. 20,000/- with two sureties each for a likesum to the satisfaction of the Court of the Special Judge for Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act-cum-Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, Vijayawada.
It is needless to mention here that as and when the Criminal Appeal comes up for hearing, the appellant shall be present before this Court, without fail.
Accordingly, I.A.No. 1 of 2020 is allowed.
